builds.governing_idea: The denominator is the design: every trial the agent ran stays on the screen in grey, so the six that survived can be priced.

signature_world.camera_path: single axis dolly forward through four gate planes, then a quarter turn to elevation over the six survivors

palette.color_story: grey ladder with one surviving phosphor

builds.loader_transition: trial grid fill gauge: 48 cells outline in step with real load, then Flip into the hero lattice

builds.archetype: Magazine or Cover Story (cast as a printed research note)
builds.governing_idea: Provenance made visible: the committee memo is a stack of paper you can see through, and every figure on the page has a hairline back to the disclosure row that produced it.

signature_world.object: a committee memo as a stack of five translucent paper sheets in depth (memo, comparables, model run, screen definition, disclosure file) joined by hairline provenance leaders
signature_world.camera_path: orthographic reading view snaps into a raking perspective as the sheets fan apart in depth, a focus pull walks from the memo to the disclosure sheet at the back and returns, then the sheets collate flat and the camera settles to the reading view

palette.color_story: paper and ink with one institutional accent

builds.motif: the provenance leader: a hairline with a hollow source circle and a terminal tick, joining a figure to the row it came from
builds.loader_transition: ruled sheet draw-on: ruling lines draw across blank paper in step with real load stages, the wordmark impresses onto the top rule, the rules dissolve into the hero grid
builds.nav_style: printed masthead between a top hairline and a bottom double rule, mono small-cap horizontal links with rising footnote marks on hover, dateline and folio cart at right, compresses to a single rule on scroll
builds.button_style: stamped rectangle: solid Prussian blue with an inset paper hairline, serif label with mono price, hairline steps outward on hover, platen press on click, slow hairline breathe at idle
builds.typographic_set_piece: Footnotes That Walk: the superscript footnote marks in the hero paragraph lift out of the prose on scroll and travel down hairline leaders into the evidence table beneath, landing on the row each figure came from
builds.voice_stance: sceptical analyst who shows the working and names what would break it
invented_techniques: The Collation: five translucent paper sheets in depth with a BokehPass focus pull that walks from the memo to the disclosure sheet and back, then collates flat, scroll scrubbed over 1.5 vh

signature_shader_knobs.application: shading and shadow tones only via a luminance threshold at 0.82 (type on textures stays crisp), fine engraving scale rather than newspaper
signature_shader_knobs.coverage: hero canvas only, never DOM text

builds.archetype: Swiss or Modular Grid (cast as the Operations Ledger Grid)
builds.governing_idea: The overnight queue: a lender's operations floor after hours where the loan files clear themselves row by row, and every figure that lands does so beside the page that proves it, so the morning underwriter only has to read and sign.

signature_world.object: the overnight queue wall: a tall graphite ledger wall of sixty loan rows standing on the operations floor, each row a thin slab of mono cells with a queue counter plate at the top right
signature_world.camera_path: first person crane straight up the wall face as rows clear beneath the camera, a held stop two thirds up for The Clear (the last twelve rows clearing in a cascade), then a straight dolly back off the wall until the cleared queue sits square in the frame as the product's queue table

palette.color_story: graphite ledger with paper type and one verdigris figure

builds.motif: the tally (four hairline strokes crossed by a fifth diagonal) plus a square package seal ruled like a form box
builds.loader_transition: drum counter of real load in Fragment Mono with load stages gaining tally strokes, then the graphite plate splits along its ledger rules (alternate rows slide out left and right) revealing the hero
builds.nav_style: ruled cell nav: one ledger header row divided by vertical hairlines, cells fill paper from the bottom rule on hover with the label inverting to ink, mono row index on the active cell, drum count cart cell top right, compresses to 48px on scroll
builds.button_style: paper block button: solid paper rectangle, radius 0, ink label with a mono price cell divided by a vertical hairline, label carriage returns 4px and a second rule draws on hover, 1px depress on press; accent never on any button; the Pilot is a text link
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Recalculation: the qualifying income figure in Fragment Mono at 160px rolls through the Form 1084 add backs on scroll, cites typing in, and takes verdigris only when it lands

builds.archetype: Meander (invented, the brook spine): one continuous generative line swings across the full viewport width down the whole page, every section docks on the bank opposite the swing so both halves of every width are occupied, section labels ride the line as standing tags, and media bands run edge to edge where the line straightens
builds.governing_idea: Every receipt you ever paid is one long tape, and Brainbrook keeps the whole tape crisp so the money printed on it can still come back.

signature_world.object: one continuous thermal receipt tape carrying the household's whole ledger, meandering like a brook across a pale celadon field, with HSA and FSA tags standing on its owed back lines
signature_world.camera_path: low rail ride along the winding tape from today's line back to the oldest receipt while faded print resolves crisp beneath the camera, then a straight lift up the axis to a held birdseye where the tape reads as a brook and the tags light back toward today, then a descent to the tape's end as it tears off into the phone's ledger

builds.signature_move_id: TYP-024 (invented: The Long Receipt, built on 3DW-007 mechanics)
builds.signature_move_category: Typography (kinetic ledger type on a procedural 3D ribbon)

palette.field: light celadon (a hued pale field, not cream or paper)
palette.color_story: brook celadon with white receipts and one copper tag

builds.body_font: Source Serif 4 (prose) with Recursive Mono Linear (figures and receipt lines)
builds.motif: the standing tag on the tape line: a ruled tape line with a notched, hole punched copper tag standing up from it; the Kept seal (perforated ring, BRAINBROOK / KEPT, a tag at the centre)
builds.loader_transition: the print head: a white receipt strip prints the real load stages as line items with dotted leaders and the word kept, the total line carries the real percentage, the strip tears along a perforated edge at 100 and Flips into the header dock at the near end of the hero tape
builds.nav_style: the tape header: a full width white receipt strip with a perforated bottom edge, Recursive wordmark top left, horizontal links with a small copper tag that stands up under the active link, a folded receipt cart with its count top right, thins to 56px and the perforation becomes one hairline on scroll
builds.button_style: the kept tag: a tag shaped button with a notched left end and a punched hole, copper fill with a white Recursive label and tabular price, lifts 2px onto a soft shadow while the hole's string draws out on hover, settles flat on press, slow shadow breath at idle; secondary is a white paper tag with a copper hairline
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Kept Line: the H1 prints as a receipt line in Recursive Mono (MONO 1, CASL 0, wght 500) and settles into the household voice (MONO 0, CASL 0.65, wght 720) as the line is kept, the owed back figure landing in tabular figures with the copper tag docking at its end
builds.interactive_feature: sorter (Empty the shoebox at /shoebox: household size, receipts a year, unclaimed earlier years, then drag eight sample receipts onto the HSA or FSA tag and mark Owed back or Reimbursed; the tape prints the owed back total by year and the next date and names Free or Plus with a Purchase Plus or Start Free button)
builds.voice_stance: the friend who already filed it (calm, a little satisfied, shows the drawer)
builds.engine_profile: baseline-r128 (Three.js r128 self hosted, lazy after first paint, no post processing, no shadow maps)
invented_techniques: TYP-024 The Long Receipt: the household ledger typeset onto a procedural ribbon (CanvasTexture on a curve swept BufferGeometry) with a scroll scrubbed camera ride, a per line fade to crisp reveal, standing tag planes, and a tear off handoff into the DOM product shot; Three.js r128 plus GSAP ScrollTrigger
builds.full_page_rule: media and layout fill the full page at every desktop width: two bank grids with auto fit content columns (two at 1440, three at 1920, four at 2560), media bands edge to edge, gutters clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 48px), no centered narrow column
